newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai phone shares down on poor third qtr results.
newsitem.headline: Thai phone shares down on poor third qtr results.

text.p: Shares of two Thai fixed phone lines operator, TelecomAsia Plc and Thai Telephone and Telecommunications, were under selling pressure on Friday due to their poor third quarter results, analysts said.
"Their net profit in the third quarter was lower than previously expected. That caused selling of the shares today," said one broker at Ekachart Finance.
At 0746 GMT, TelecomAsia was down two baht to 60.50 baht on the most active trade of 412 million baht. Thai Telephone was off three baht to 49.50 on 87 million baht turnover.
